presentation.label: Blank the screen with UP + NO
presentation.summary: Hold UP and tap NO to blank the screen until the same chord. Sound, the sequencer and the other keys keep going.
presentation.overview: The MKII already dims its OLED after five quiet minutes and turns it off after an hour, and only while the sequencer is stopped. Screen Off blanks the glass at once, including while a pattern plays, and leaves it blank until you ask for it back. The trig lamps stay lit, so a running pattern is still visible on the keys.
highlights: Hold UP and tap NO. The screen goes black. The same chord brings it back.
Every other key and every knob still does what it did. The screen stays black while you use them.
UP alone and NO alone are unchanged. NO still disarms, or steps back in a list.
Nothing is stored in the project. A power cycle turns the screen back on.
usage: Hold UP and tap NO. The screen goes black. Let go of both keys.
Press PLAY, change a pattern or turn a knob. The action happens and the screen stays black.
Hold UP and tap NO again. The screen returns to the page you were on.

access.location: Front panel: hold UP, tap NO
steps: Hold UP and tap NO. The screen goes black. Let go of both keys.
Press PLAY, change a pattern or turn a knob. The action happens and the screen stays black.
Hold UP and tap NO again. The screen returns to the page you were on.
access.noUiReason: It draws nothing of its own. Hold UP and tap NO and the stock screen goes black until the same chord.

limitations: OS 1.40C. The author reports that on a MKII the chord blanks the screen and brings it back. It needs the Modwerk base: the base passes keys and the composed frame to the module.

The blank clears the pixels. On a MKII that leaves the OLED dark. Whether the panel's own power-off command can be used as well is not yet known. On an MKI the backlight may stay lit behind a blank glass.
The screen stays black until UP + NO again, including while other keys and knobs do their usual jobs. You will not see the result until the screen is back.
Holding UP already moves the highlight in a list by one step before NO blanks the screen. That NO does not disarm and does not answer a question.
The blank is forgotten at power-on. It is not saved with the Part or the project. The stock screen saver still runs when this blank is off.
Known issue: not yet tested on the MKI, or beside the stock screen saver while a pattern plays.

storage.label: ColdFire unit
storage.conditions: Package 14aea62fbfef825e2ea23cc4baf6e01a2f2b0bf44b215db28748c1a546aeae0c. Linked image 256 bytes (250 of code, 2 of alignment, the 4-byte so_at pointer) plus 12 bytes of bss. The redraw path pushes 4 bytes on the UI stack. No heap and no DSP memory. The composed frame is stock's.

processing.label: ColdFire, per key and per composed frame
processing.conditions: ot_emu executed instructions from so_draw's entry to its rts, interrupts included, blank on. 26 clears of the frame took 6157 with no interrupt inside the draw. The dearest was 25033. This is not a chip wall-clock count.

impact.conditions: UI task: one key chord, and a frame clear only while the blank is on.

cpu.rationale: The chord is a handful of compares. The clear is 1024 bytes on the UI draw, and only while the screen is black. Nothing runs in the audio interrupt.

dsp.rationale: No DSP code. The blank only clears the composed frame on the UI task.

memory.rationale: 256 bytes of linked image, 12 bytes of state, and a 4-byte push on the redraw path. No heap and no DSP memory.

cpuPrice.conditions: MKII, OS 1.40C, development twin 878307834ad3c23a RAM-booted (no controller rows, not flashed). Package 14aea62fbfef825e2ea23cc4baf6e01a2f2b0bf44b215db28748c1a546aeae0c, built before this twin. One 8 s reading, pattern left as the unit came up, transport stopped beforehand, module installed and the blank off. Frame interrupt +0.0 points. The CPU meter read +1.7 and is not this price.

tests.summary: Host gate on screen_off.c. The author reports that on a MKII the chord blanks the screen and brings it back, and that a power cycle brought the screen back on with the module still installed. An MKI was not tried.

conditions.parameterExtremes: There is no parameter. The blank is off or on, and the dearest draw is the clear of the 1024-byte frame.
conditions.parameterModulation: No LFO, p-lock, MIDI CC or scene reaches this module. The chord is the only control, and it was the event that was counted.
conditions.modeSwitching: One UP+NO turned the blank on. A later run sent STOP and PART+RIGHT, which changed the Part byte from 0 to 1, then PLAY, between two groups of the same chord.
conditions.maxLoad: One instance. It takes no track, no FX slot and no DSP core. The count is one draw, not a sum across tracks.
conditions.inputConditions: With the blank off the draw returned in 10 instructions. With it on, 26 clears took 6157 and the dearest, the same clear with an interrupt inside it, took 25033. That count is executed instructions, not chip wall-clock cycles, and it does not bound the stock redraw call.

regions.name: Redraw argument on the UI stack

memory.conditions: ABI 8 package 14aea62fbfef825e2ea23cc4baf6e01a2f2b0bf44b215db28748c1a546aeae0c, image 256 bytes and bss 12, one instance. The 4-byte figure is the only push in the image. Stock's stack under the redraw call, the composed frame and the held-key row are not this module's. No heap, no table, no DSP memory. Hardware canaries were not measured.

hardware.summary: On a MKII, OS 1.40C, the author reports that hold UP, tap NO blanks the screen and the same chord brings it back, including in a list, the sample editor, the arranger and the status page. On 18 November 2026 the same package was kept, the author powered the unit off and on, and they report the screen came back on with the module still installed. Removal while the screen was black brought the page back and the chord no longer blanked it. A try without keeping rolled back. No SAVE and no flash.
limitations: The blank and the restore are the author's report. The log shows the tick word, not a photograph of the glass.
An MKI was not tried. A card install was not tried.
The stock screen saver, the OLED power-off command and the MKI backlight were not tried.
Part save and project save were not tried. The blank is not stored.
No audio was measured. This module writes no samples.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial
steps: Hold UP and tap NO. The screen goes black. Let go of both keys.
Press PLAY, or turn a knob. The Octatrack does it, and the screen stays black. The trig lamps still show the pattern.
Hold UP and tap NO again. The screen returns to the page you left.
